Oberoi Realty Sells Luxury Homes Worth Over ₹8,100 Crore in Delhi-NCR

Oberoi Realty has reported significant sales figures from its first luxury housing project in the Delhi-NCR region. The company sold homes valued at ₹8,109 crore. This marks a substantial achievement for the real estate developer in a new market.
